challenges.title: Choke points
challenges.task: Follow the supply links behind an AI GPU and find three companies that are the only maker of what they supply.
challenges.hint: Start at ASML and read what it buys and from whom.
challenges.why: ASML is the only maker of EUV scanners; Zeiss makes all of their mirrors and optics; Trumpf makes the lasers that create the light. Every leading-edge chip passes through all three, and each would take years to replace.

learn.plain: Making a chip is like a relay race run across a dozen countries: designers in California, toolmakers in the Netherlands and Japan, factories in Taiwan, memory in Korea. If any runner stops, the whole race stops, and some runners have no substitute.
learn.engineer: Concentration follows economies of scale and learning: leading-edge logic in Taiwan, HBM in Korea, EUV in the Netherlands, resists, wafers and ABF film in Japan, gallium and rare-earth refining in China. Resilience levers are inventory (weeks to months), multi-sourcing (requires 6–12 months of requalification per product and node) and geographic diversification (years, and higher cost per wafer). Export controls weaponize the same chokepoints. EDA has three main vendors, and HBM has three suppliers. Concentration also sets pricing power and how quickly new entrants can change the structure.

quiz.q: Why can't a chip shortage be fixed quickly by switching suppliers?
options: Moving a design to a new fab or supplier takes months of requalification, and many steps have only one or two suppliers
Chips cannot be shipped by air
quiz.why: Each product is qualified on one process; a new fab means new masks, tests and approvals, typically 6–12 months.

quiz.q: Which region makes most of the world's HBM memory?
quiz.why: SK hynix and Samsung together make about three-quarters of HBM; Micron makes most of the rest.

quiz.q: If ASML stopped shipping EUV scanners, what would happen first?
options: All chips would stop at once
Installed scanners keep running, but new capacity stops and uptime slowly falls without parts and service
Nothing, because there are other suppliers
quiz.why: There is no second EUV supplier, but the damage builds gradually rather than all at once.

quiz.q: Who is the only maker of EUV lithography scanners?
quiz.why: ASML, in the Netherlands, is a classic chokepoint in the chain.

options: One that designs chips but pays a foundry to make them
quiz.why: NVIDIA, AMD, Apple and Qualcomm are fabless; TSMC is their foundry.

quiz.q: Which three companies supply almost all professional chip-design (EDA) software?
quiz.why: All three launched autonomous AI agents for chip design in 2026.
